content: 15-second action-comedy short, polished cinematic realism with calm spiritual contrast. Same subject throughout: a serene monk in flowing saffron robes riding a skateboard through a giant temple courtyard. 0–3s: he stands motionless on the board as incense smoke drifts around him. 3–6s: he suddenly pushes off and glides down stone steps with impossible balance. 6–10s: he weaves through prayer wheels, lantern poles, and pigeons without disturbing his peaceful expression. 10–15s: he lands a flawless spinning trick, steps off gently, and bows as the skateboard rolls back to his feet.
